source.method: Parallel research sweeps over InaExport (Kemendag), Trade Expo Indonesia & IFEX exhibitor directories, government export releases (Bea Cukai, Kemenperin, LPEI), company sites, documented news, and — for the marketplace tier — the companies’ own international storefronts. Every row carries the page it was compiled from, except where that page was not recorded as a link.

method.ranking: verification tier, then reachability (email > website > phone), then name

verified_shipper.label: Verified shipper
verified_shipper.def: Listed on InaExport (Kemendag’s verified exporter platform) AND a documented shipment on record — the strongest evidence tier we hold.

confirmed_shipper.label: Confirmed shipper
confirmed_shipper.def: A specific export shipment documented in the press or an official release (Bea Cukai, Kemenperin, LPEI), read and linked on the row.

inaexport.label: InaExport-verified
inaexport.def: Listed on InaExport, where Kemendag verifies exporter legality documents before a profile is published.

tradeshow.label: Trade-show exhibitor
tradeshow.def: Exhibited at a vetted international trade show (Trade Expo Indonesia, IFEX, MIHAS and peers) per the show’s own directory or an official release.

export_listed.label: Export-listed
export_listed.def: Export activity or export-readiness stated in a public listing, directory or report — the source link says exactly what was claimed and where.

marketplace.label: Marketplace seller
marketplace.def: The company runs its own international storefront (Etsy, Instagram, Shopee, Alibaba) and the shop itself is the evidence. It shows they sell and ship abroad at retail scale — it is not evidence of wholesale export capability, and no third party has checked it.
